name: Black Bayou Gas Storage header pipelines

values.PipelineName: Black Bayou Gas Storage Header Pipelines
values.StartLocation: Black Bayou salt dome storage site, Cameron and Calcasieu Parishes
values.EndLocation: Interconnects with 10 interstate pipelines, Cameron and Calcasieu Parishes

researcher_notes: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission environmental assessment notice from April 2025 (docket CP24-494) describes two looped, two-way header pipelines of 24 inches, each 27.1 miles long, as part of the Black Bayou Gas Storage Project in Cameron and Calcasieu Parishes, Louisiana. The sponsor is Black Bayou Gas Storage, LLC. The EIA May 2026 release (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 15) lists the project as Approved, 24 inches, 54.2 miles in total, with a certificate issued 10/1/2025, first caverns in service in Q4 2028, and the project advancing toward a final investment decision. The EIA row names the sponsor as Black Bayou Energy Hub, LLC. The row is not in the Aug 2026 EIA release. Length is the sum of the two 27.1 mile lines (total 54.2 miles, above the 15.5 mile threshold); the two lines run side by side, so route length is about 27 miles. No existing roster row matches. The nearest rows (TransCameron, ANR Offshore Grand Chenier) are different pipes. Capacity of the headers is not stated (storage peak 2.0 Bcf/d deliverability, 1.6 Bcf/d injection). Exact endpoint coordinates not found. EIA lists this as intrastate; the FERC docket is a storage certificate. The two sources are different publishers but EIA draws on the FERC record, so independence is not claimed. No route researched. Confidence high for existence, status, size and length. The owner has no match in the entity list, so it is recorded as the source spells it.
